dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean work at The Flagship?

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Ah, no, I'm talking about the Fatui recruiter in there. Guy called Kruchek. Don't fall for his schemes, and don't let him hire you!

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: I'm speaking from personal experience — I don't care about the low pay, but my friends who took those jobs just up and vanished. Never saw them again.
